# One pinned upstream renderer source graph for host and all Android ABIs.
set(archive "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libopenmpt-0.8.9.tar.gz")
file(SHA256 "${archive}" digest)
if(NOT digest STREQUAL "d7ce84fd05d686c4bcf66af40eae857afa371442db60eeda3f874bd6cf6fc318")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libopenmpt source archive integrity failure")
endif()
set(source_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source/libopenmpt-0.8.9+release.autotools")
if(NOT EXISTS "${source_root}/Makefile.am")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source")
    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source")
endif()
# Keep the archive original. This local hook seeds each renderer before load,
# never reseeding process-global state; unknown initial ctls are upstream-safe.
set(implementation "${source_root}/libopenmpt/libopenmpt_impl.cpp")
file(READ "${implementation}" contents)
set(anchor "m_sndFile = std::make_unique<OpenMPT::CSoundFile>();")
set(hook "${anchor}\n\t// PLAYER2: content-derived deterministic per-source PRNG.\n\tconst auto player2Seed = ctls.find(\"player2.seed\");\n\tif(player2Seed != ctls.end()) m_sndFile->Player2Seed(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoull(player2Seed->second)));")
# Upgrade the initial local hook without exposing its protected PRNG reference.
string(REPLACE "m_sndFile->AccessPRNG() = OpenMPT::mpt::fast_prng(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoull(player2Seed->second)))"
    "m_sndFile->Player2Seed(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(std::stoull(player2Seed->second)))" contents "${contents}")
if(NOT contents MATCHES "PLAYER2: content-derived")
    string(FIND "${contents}" "${anchor}" location)
    if(location LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned libopenmpt seed hook no longer matches")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE "${anchor}" "${hook}" contents "${contents}")
endif()
# Exact tick boundaries for worker-side source-position inspection. The pinned
# mixer consumes this count synchronously; no approximate seconds conversion.
if(NOT contents MATCHES "PLAYER2: exact source tick boundary")
    set(anchor "std::int64_t module_impl::ctl_get_integer( std::string_view ctl, bool throw_if_unknown ) const {")
    string(FIND "${contents}" "${anchor}" location)
    if(location LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned libopenmpt tick observation hook no longer matches")
    endif()
    set(hook "${anchor}\n\t// PLAYER2: exact source tick boundary, worker observation only.\n\tif(ctl == \"player2.tick_remaining\") return m_sndFile->Player2TickRemaining();")
    string(REPLACE "${anchor}" "${hook}" contents "${contents}")
endif()
string(REPLACE "m_sndFile->m_PlayState.m_nBufferCount" "m_sndFile->Player2TickRemaining()" contents "${contents}")
file(READ "${implementation}" previous)
if(NOT previous STREQUAL contents)
    file(WRITE "${implementation}" "${contents}")
endif()
set(sound_header "${source_root}/soundlib/Sndfile.h")
file(READ "${sound_header}" contents)
if(NOT contents MATCHES "void Player2Seed")
    set(anchor "public:\n\tPlayState m_PlayState;")
    string(FIND "${contents}" "${anchor}" location)
    if(location LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned libopenmpt seed member hook no longer matches")
    endif()
    set(hook "public:\n\t// PLAYER2: seed only before source load, without exposing PRNG state.\n\tvoid Player2Seed(uint32 seed) { m_PRNG = mpt::fast_prng(seed); }\n\tPlayState m_PlayState;")
    string(REPLACE "${anchor}" "${hook}" contents "${contents}")
    file(WRITE "${sound_header}" "${contents}")
endif()
file(READ "${sound_header}" contents)
if(NOT contents MATCHES "Player2TickRemaining")
    set(anchor "PlayState m_PlayState;")
    string(FIND "${contents}" "${anchor}" location)
    if(location LESS 0)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned libopenmpt tick member hook no longer matches")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE "${anchor}" "${anchor}\n\tsamplecount_t Player2TickRemaining() const { return m_PlayState.m_nBufferCount; }" contents "${contents}")
    file(WRITE "${sound_header}" "${contents}")
endif()
# Derive translation units from the pinned upstream manifest, not a copied list.
include(prepare_mo3.cmake)
file(STRINGS "${source_root}/Makefile.am" manifest)
set(renderer_sources)
foreach(line IN LISTS manifest)
    if(line MATCHES "^(MPT_FILES_(SRC_MPT|SRC_OPENMPT|COMMON|SOUNDBASE|SOUNDLIB|SOUNDDSP)|libopenmpt_la_SOURCES) \\+= ([^ $]+\\.cpp)$")
        list(APPEND renderer_sources "${source_root}/${CMAKE_MATCH_3}")
    endif()
endforeach()
list(LENGTH renderer_sources source_count)
if(NOT source_count EQUAL 149)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned libopenmpt manifest count mismatch: ${source_count}")
endif()
# Preserve pinned upstream provenance and honestly mark the local seed patch.
set_source_files_properties("${source_root}/common/version.cpp" PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS
    "MPT_SVNVERSION=\"25652M\";MPT_SVNDATE=\"2026-08-19T07:15:57.388610Z\";MPT_SVNURL=\"https://source.openmpt.org/svn/openmpt/tags/libopenmpt-0.8.9\";MPT_PACKAGE=1")
add_library(player2_module_renderer STATIC ${renderer_sources})
add_subdirectory(mo3-codecs)
target_link_libraries(player2_module_renderer PRIVATE player2_mo3_codecs)
target_compile_definitions(player2_module_renderer PRIVATE ${PLAYER2_MO3_VORBIS_NAMES})
target_compile_features(player2_module_renderer PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(player2_module_renderer PUBLIC LIBOPENMPT_STATIC PRIVATE LIBOPENMPT_BUILD NO_PLUGINS MPT_WITH_MINIMP3 MPT_WITH_STBVORBIS)
target_include_directories(player2_module_renderer PUBLIC "${source_root}" PRIVATE "${source_root}/src" "${source_root}/common")
set_target_properties(player2_module_renderer PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
